'''Hop Stone''' was a game that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Barth]] played in their cell while they were captured by the [[Yevetha]]. There were a solitary version and a two-player version.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
